title: Install Radar — Field Snapshot (week of 2026-06-17)
content:
Context:
Quick snapshot from the field-install cadence this week. This doc is intentionally terse — capture of standup blurbs, emergent blockers, and action routing before formalizing into the runbook. Mostly VPC + onprem installs in EU/NA with one air-gapped pilot.

Agenda (today):
- 10m: Quick state of active installs (status, ETA)
- 15m: High-impact blockers + mitigation decisions
- 10m: Handoffs / customer comms / next steps

Standup snippets (by person):
- Priya: ZenithCorp (onprem) day2: observed NVMe throughput variance on node-3 after firmware v2.1. I/O benchmarks show 25% lower bandwidth vs lab. Suspect BIOS power profile (C-states). Raised JIRA-ENG-2319. Customer asked to delay canary traffic until we validate patch.
- Daniel: VPC install for Meridian (EU): BGP sessions flapping between customer edge and our transit; root cause appears to be asymmetric route advertisement from customer CPE (Cisco 9300). Working with customer networking; temporary mitigation applied: forced static route for 10.32.0.0/16. Ticket PRIVDEP-144.
- Marta: Onprem air-gapped pilot (Pharos): KMS integration failing during bootstrap — HSM token not visible to agent on node-bootstrap due to SELinux policy on their appliance. We have a workaround script but need formal exception in onboarding checklist.
- Ethan: Observability agent CPU spike on customer edge during batch-replay; traced to old fluentd config flooding local disk and triggering kubelet eviction. Reverted to lighter config; working on throttling rules for replays.

Emergent blockers (priority ordered):
1) NVMe perf regression (ZenithCorp) — high impact, blocks production canary.
   - Symptoms: sustained 25% lower write BW after BIOS update; benchmark reproducible in customer rack only.
   - Immediate mitigation: revert BIOS profile -> pending site tech coord and SLA window.
   - Owner: Priya (action: coordinate with site tech & node vendor). Due: 2026-06-19 EOD.
   - Risk: if revert not allowed, consider moving canary to dedicated warm pool in NA for 48h.
2) BGP asymmetry (Meridian) — mid/high impact for VPC peering stability.
   - Symptoms: flaps every ~7–12 minutes during peak; routes dropped for <1m but LB healthchecks fail.
   - Mitigation: static route applied; customer to push fix to CPE staging.
   - Owner: Daniel (with customer networking). Due: 2026-06-20 morning.
3) KMS/HSM visibility in air-gapped boot (Pharos) — blocks secrets provisioning.
   - Symptoms: agent bootstrap fails at step 3 with timeout waiting for token.
   - Mitigation: use pre-seeded token via secure USB as temporary bypass; document manual step.
   - Owner: Marta. Follow-up: add onboarding checklist item + confluence doc. Due: 2026-06-21.
4) Observability replay CPU spike — intermittent; impacts edge stability during large backfills.
   - Owner: Ethan. Action: land throttling config and add monitoring alert for local disk pressure. Due: 2026-06-22.

Decisions made during meeting:
- Delay ZenithCorp canary until either BIOS revert or we can deploy canary to warm pool. Decision logged in JIRA-ENG-2319 comment thread.
- For BGP flaps we keep static route for 48h; if flaps persist after customer patch, escalate to netops to perform packet capture.
- Approve the manual USB token fallback for one-time air-gapped boot, but require HSM vendor sign-off before making it part of standard runbook.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Is the ZenithCorp firmware widely deployed across other customers? (Priya: quick search shows 3 installs with same vendor board; need inventory mapping).
- Can we automate the BIOS profile check in preflight (quick check in installer)? Idea: add nvme-bench smoke test to preflight-2.
- KMS provisioning: should we formalize a signed, short-lived fallback token process for air-gapped sites? Security input needed.

Action items (owner / due / status):
- Priya: Coordinate on-site NVMe BIOS revert and vendor RMA/diagnostics. Due 2026-06-19. Status: in_progress.
- Daniel: Validate static-route stability + get capture permissions from customer if not resolved. Due 2026-06-20. Status: in_progress.
- Marta: Draft confluence entry for KMS manual fallback and update onboarding checklist. Due 2026-06-21. Status: todo.
- Ethan: Implement replay throttling config, add alert for disk pressure, and run load test. Due 2026-06-22. Status: todo.
- Ops: Create warm-pool canary plan runbook for moving canaries cross-region (owner: ops-scheduler). Due 2026-06-23. Status: todo.

Notes & micro-logs (raw):
- 06:05 UTC: NVMe bench: seq write 875 MB/s (lab baseline 1160 MB/s). Smartctl: no immediate errors.
- 08:42 UTC: BGP flap trace shows neighbor reset by remote (Customer CPE).
- 10:10 UTC: HSM vendor on call — SELinux booleans cause token socket to be blocked. Quickfix applied.

Customer comms snippets (for triage channel and support reply):
- ZenithCorp: "We're pausing the canary until we get a vendor confirmation — we will prioritize the BIOS revert during your maintenance window. We'll share the diagnostic logs by EOD."
- Meridian: "We've opened TAC with our network provider; temporary static route in place. Expect patch by tomorrow morning."
- Pharos: "We accepted a one-time manual provisioning step. Please provide the confluence instructions and the signed acceptance document."

Follow-ups for next sync:
- Share NVMe inventory across onprem installs and mark any with same board/fw.
- Draft preflight test for storage perf.
- Security to advise on acceptable air-gap token fallback (contact: security@redwood.ai).

Raw links / refs:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Install+Runbook+v2
- Ticket: JIRA-ENG-2319 (NVMe perf)
- Ticket: PRIVDEP-144 (Meridian BGP)
- Slack threads: #deploy-field (pinned: /thread/CTC12345/BGP-merge), #install-sherpas

Quick pulse: 6 installs active this week, 3 in steady state, 2 with medium blockers, 1 on-hold for canary.

Notes to self: move the NVMe bench into the installer as optional smoke (flag: --run-storage-smoke). Add checklist item for SELinux/HSM booleans.

-- end of snapshot --
